About

Minbo Park (박민보) loves adventure. That’s why he joined the army, then quit the army, then started coaching women’s volleyball, and then won a bronze medal in the World Cup with his team. So when Minbo is contacted by the current coach of a foreign country’s team with the solemn request of “Please take us to the Olympics”; Minbo Park packs his bags and books a plane ticket. It is his first time in the South Omericon continent, and his first time hearing Spanish, but he is just as excited as “The Matadoras”. That’s how Minbo calls the twelve players during his first training session: it is the road to the Olympics!
